extracted.name: Homemade croissants
instruction_lines: Mix these all ingredients to make a nice soft dough Now let it rise over night.
Now make croissants from it give it any shape you love just roll it and twist around.
Now place it on foil n brush with oil and egg. Preheat oven to 420 degrees and bake it for 20 minutes or when nicely cooked.
